summary:
This bill is a joint resolution. A joint resolution is a kind of bill Congress can use to make an official decision.

It says Congress does not approve a law passed by the District of Columbia Council. That D.C. law is called the Comprehensive Policing and Justice Reform Amendment Act of 2022. The D.C. Council passed it on January 19, 2023. It was sent to Congress on January 26, 2023, under the D.C. Home Rule Act. That law sets rules for how D.C. governs itself and how Congress can review D.C. laws.

If this joint resolution becomes law, Congress would reject the D.C. Council’s policing and justice reform law. The text does not describe the details of the D.C. law. It only says Congress disapproves of the Council’s action in passing it.

The House of Representatives passed this resolution on April 19, 2023. It was received in the Senate on April 20, 2023, and sent to a Senate committee for review.
